sources.title: Danfoss AB-QM pressure-independent control valve data sheet
sources.supports: Integrated differential-pressure regulation and flow limitation; size-dependent operating differential and flow capacity; specified control accuracy.
sources.model_mapping: Generic ideal PICV uses a 35 kPa minimum differential and a 414 kPa upper-envelope check, with a separate 5 kPa study reserve. These rounded study values are not a selected AB-QM size or calibrated product curve. Below the minimum, a synthetic open-orifice law is used. Real +/-5% setpoint accuracy is not included in the ideal plateau.

sources.title: US DOE / Hydraulic Institute, Improving Pumping System Performance, second edition
sources.supports: Pump speed, system resistance and throttling must be evaluated together; flow and power depend on the system operating point.
sources.model_mapping: Solve the inherited pump curve with each network; compare fixed commissioned speed and recalculated steady speed limited to 100%. Fixed efficiencies are inherited; no dynamic control or measured energy-saving claim.
